description: Search the Mississippi Code of 1972 BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "security deposit", "concealed carry", "DUI per se limit", "homicide". Matches against every section's official CATCHLINE across the whole Code (not full statutory body text — there is no full-text search anywhere in this source chain; the official LexisNexis tool, Justia, and FindLaw all sit behind the same Cloudflare bot-check, confirmed live). Returns matching citations, titles, and catchlines; call ms_code_section with a citation for the full text. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "security deposit return".

name: ms_code_search
title: Ms Code Search
